snippet.title: Viking Frontiers - Release Date Teaser | Blum Entertainment
snippet.description:
Wishlist now at 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/
Play the free Prologue version 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/

The Blum Entertainment team is thrilled to announce the official release date of the Viking Frontiers project. On April 24, 2025, you will be able to take on the role of the powerful Jarl and lead your own Viking clan. Don't forget to mark this date in your calendar and add the game to your Steam Wishlist. The greatest Norse adventure is about to begin!


Try your hand as a Viking ruler and enjoy features such as:

🗡 An engaging survival system
🗡 Management of clansmen’s needs, work and condition
🗡 A plot that will guide you through your new Jarl role
🗡 Beautiful, realistic graphics that allow you to experience everything from a first-person perspective
🗡 Addictive gameplay steeped in an authentic Viking vibe 

Stay up to date:

Discord - https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy
Facebook -  https://www.facebook.com/blumentmt
Twitter / X - https://twitter.com/BlumEntmt
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/blumentmt/
Website - https://blumentmt.com/
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue/
